long_biography.plain_text:
Jürgen Stefan Lange leads Frankfurt-based JSLM AG as its board member. The company manages investments and provides management consulting while developing and marketing software, network and systems solutions. Lange's role combines holding-company governance with direct oversight of operating businesses in information technology.

His executive record includes long-running management of software companies. He has directed JSLM Products & Services since 2012 and became managing director of digital office 24 in 2023. Earlier roles included KEOS Software Service, which later merged into JSLM Products & Services, and MUSICO AG, a developer of music websites and applications. Together, these appointments trace a sustained focus on enterprise software and digital products.
